title: "Schedule"

## 30-Hour Course Schedule

| Block | Duration | Topic |
|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | 5 h | Introduction to Julia and thermofluid simulation |
| 2 | 5 h | Project 1: Cooling of a hot steel cube |
| 3 | 5 h | Project 2: Cooling of coffee in a mug |
| 4 | 5 h | Project 3: Heating of water in an L-shaped pipe |
| 5 | 5 h | Project 4: Natural convection in a square cavity |
| 6 | 5 h | Project 5: Flow and heat transfer over a heated flat plate |

## Introductory Block

| Time | Activity |
|---:|---|
| 0:00–0:45 | Julia basics |
| 0:45–1:30 | Governing equations |
| 1:30–2:15 | Heat equation and finite differences |
| 2:15–3:00 | Boundary conditions |
| 3:00–3:45 | ODE models and `DifferentialEquations.jl` |
| 3:45–4:30 | Plotting and post-processing |
| 4:30–5:00 | Assignment of projects and group setup |

## Generic Project Block

| Time | Activity |
|---:|---|
| 0:00–0:45 | Problem formulation and assumptions |
| 0:45–1:30 | Governing equations and nondimensional numbers |
| 1:30–2:30 | Numerical or ML/PINN implementation |
| 2:30–3:30 | Results, plotting, debugging |
| 3:30–4:30 | Parameter study and verification |
| 4:30–5:00 | Discussion and reporting |
